macs_reference.convention: Same published profiling implementation: one multiply-accumulate=one MAC; fvcore supported operations plus explicit complex 3x3 propagation. Uncounted operators listed. Extra half-delay scalar interpolation reported separately; not hardware instruction counts. MACs do not measure latency or memory.

details.timing_scope: CUDA-synchronized wall time around existing forward including tile assembly/clamp for tiled evaluation; excludes image decoding, H2D and quality metrics. Dataset evaluation wall time remains separate. No extra warmup/repeated images. Shared host contention and first-call overhead retained.
details.memory_scope: PyTorch process allocated/reserved peaks in MiB; forward includes resident model and input/target tensors. Evaluation peak also includes metric workspace. Not whole-device NVML usage; reserved may include allocator cache from earlier calls.
details.macs_scope: Reference batch1 RGB256x256 model MACs using recorded convention; per-image/tile call shapes also recorded. Do not treat reference MACs as a whole tiled evaluation count or measured hardware work.
